value.reported_activity: use of Chinese nationals as banking proxies for IT-worker revenue generated in China

sources.locator: Annex 7 opening narrative, PDF file p. 109 (printed p. 107)
sources.quote: DPRK IT workers affiliated with KMCTC used Chinese nationals as banking proxies in order to launder illicit funds generated from the DPRK IT workers' revenue generation efforts in China.

notes: Organization/delegation-level MSMT context only; it does not attribute personal banking-proxy use, money laundering, account control, or a transaction to this individual.
No account, proxy identity, payment, transaction, wallet, client, victim, or precise-location selector is retained.

identity_boundary: Kim Chung Hyok is the person named in the MSMT Annex 7 KMCTC employment table. Federico, Austin, Jin Tian, and Maxwell remain source-reported employment labels; civil identity, separate-person status, and present-account evidence require source support. Jin Tian is non-unique within the same table, so a merge with Kim requires a unique bridge.
